model: Dragging the home sheet between half and full height wrote a fractional header offset on every frame. That offset is the main column's top margin, so each write laid out the map. The offset now stays 0 until the sheet is fully open, then becomes the full header height once.

noise.rule: 18 is round(300ms * 60 / 1000). The final 1 is the write when progress reaches 1. A drag that never reaches full height writes 0. Not a sampled layout trace.
